findings.evidence: Every other public declaration in the file is documented (only the `private` lemmas at 185/200/215/490/497/511 are bare). The file's own declared model, `GeneralLinear/FunctorOfPoints.lean`, documents its analogues: line 174 `/-- Evaluating the point associated to an invertible matrix recovers that matrix. -/` on `pointToGeneralLinear_generalLinearToPoint`, line 183 on `generalLinearToPoint_pointToGeneralLinear`, line 163 on `generalLinearToPoint_apply`; there only `private` declarations (65, 79, 102, 108, 116, 122, 137, 256, 281) go undocumented.
findings.fix: Add one-line docstrings, e.g. `/-- Above the diagonal, the generic matrix is the corresponding polynomial coordinate. -/`, `/-- The generic matrix has ones on the diagonal. -/`, `/-- The generic matrix vanishes below the diagonal. -/`, `/-- The point associated to an upper-unitriangular matrix sends each strict-upper coordinate to the corresponding entry. -/`, `/-- Evaluating the point associated to an upper-unitriangular matrix recovers that matrix. -/`, `/-- Forming a point from the matrix read off a point recovers the original point. -/`.
findings.issue: Six public theorems have no docstring: `genericMatrix_apply_of_lt` (83), `genericMatrix_apply_diag` (88), `genericMatrix_apply_eq_zero_of_gt` (92), `upperUnitriangularToPoint_apply` (539), `pointToUpperUnitriangular_upperUnitriangularToPoint` (548), `upperUnitriangularToPoint_pointToUpperUnitriangular` (558). The first three are the only statement of what `genericMatrix` actually is (its own docstring is just "The generic upper-unitriangular matrix" over a nested `dite`); the last two are the substantive round-trip results underlying `pointsMulEquiv`.

summary: Module docstring, references, roadmap pointer, and every Main-declarations bullet check out, and the prior finding on the raw structure dictionaries is resolved (both are now private with explicit non-instance disclaimers). Six public theorems remain undocumented in a file that otherwise documents every public declaration.
